name: Burning Rock
summary: In Duskwood, Burning Rock smolders in the depths of Roland's Doom. Gutspill, leader of the Nightbane worgen, carries it, and Grimand Elmore in Stormwind needs it with fiery worgen blood to forge enchanted armor for promising warriors.

sections.title: A Smoldering Prize
sections.body: Gutspill carries Burning Rock through the shafts of Roland's Doom. Grimand Elmore in Stormwind wants its heat for armor made with fiery worgen blood. He is testing smithing techniques developed by his peer Furen Longbeard, to make tough plates for veteran fighters.

faq.q: Where is the Burning Rock found?
faq.answer: Gutspill carries Burning Rock inside Roland's Doom in eastern Duskwood.
Grimand Elmore, a dwarven smith in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, wants Burning Rock to test experimental smithing techniques.

faq.q: Why does Grimand Elmore need it?
faq.answer: Grimand plans to test crafting techniques developed by Furen Longbeard. With Nightbane worgen blood, the smoldering rock provides heat for forging a unique suit of armor.

faq.q: What connection does this rock have to the worgen?
aliases: why do worgen have burning rock
faq.answer: The Nightbane worgen in Roland's Doom have strange fiery traits, including burning blood. Their leader, Gutspill, keeps Burning Rock deep in the mine. Whether the worgen found it there or brought it with them is unknown.

angles.text: As a warrior, you brave Roland's Doom for Burning Rock. Grimand Elmore rewards your valor with custom armor forged using its heat.
As a blacksmith, you can study Burning Rock as an unusual heat source. Stormwind and Ironforge armorers explore unorthodox ways to smelt and temper armor.
